verdict.rationale: The record keeps the renewal type, the household of three, and the within-limits status. It never says the renewal is routine; 'No resident follow-up indicated' does not clearly convey that. 'Approved' and 'no follow-up' are not stated in the source. They may be the determination agent's own conclusions, so it is unclear whether they count as unsupported material facts.
